tools.name: describe_corpus_plan
tools.description: Return Corpus Plan's public SEO/GEO audit capabilities, product links, and safety notes.

tools.name: get_public_report
tools.description: Read the stored public audit report for a saved Corpus Plan share slug. Unsaved reports require saving through the website first. Only public report facts are returned.

tools.name: get_report_progress
tools.description: Read the current status and progress lines for a Corpus Plan audit behind a public report slug.

tools.name: get_report_recommendations
tools.description: Return observed findings ordered critical, major, minor, then other severities, with existing fix hints. Requires a saved public share slug, not private account access. No new crawl, invented findings or automatic fixes.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a website audited. Starts Corpus Plan's free audit of a public website (up to 20 pages of that site) and returns the overall score, the five pillar scores including AI citability, the top three issues, the Product information document and the workspace link where the use

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether AI answer engines cite their website. Asks one answer engine (Perplexity) three customer-style questions written from the site's own pages and returns each question, the sites it cited, whether this site was one of them, and the date.
